author: Priya Ndiaye, fleet engineering
notes: Twenty-four returns closed at March. Rebuilt the pack off the same notebook.
Number came back further under than the November cut did: -3.8 against -2.3. Delia is reading it as the 2022-H2 build pulling further ahead the longer it is on the road.
Age spread on the two builds as at March: the 2021-H2 vans run from twenty-seven to thirty-two months, and the 2022-H2 vans stop at fourteen, every one of them.
Build sheets: 2021-03 and 2021-04 carry the same body spec and the same two lot numbers. So do a run of other months. Programme engineering will only answer a query if you quote the sheet.
Finance asked for the audit spend line by line for the pack. Three days charged, one of them handed back.
